explanation: The Credit Agreement §7.11(b) states no add-back shall be made to Consolidated EBITDA for DSCR except as expressly amended in writing. The borrower reported an add-back of 530,000 'owner compensation normalisation' in the Compliance Certificate §3 and Financials §2. Our calculation with boarded terms (no add-backs) yields DSCR 1.08, below the required 1.25. The borrower's figure 1.31 shown in the Compliance Certificate §2 includes this add-back which is unsupported by any executed amendment or waiver on file, so the borrower's reported DSCR is not consistent with the agreement terms.
confidence_basis: The borrower applied an add-back for "owner compensation normalisation" of 530,000 not permitted by the Credit Agreement clause 7.11(b), which forbids add-backs except as expressly amended in writing, and no such amendment or waiver is on file.

claims.text: The Borrower shall not permit the Debt Service Coverage Ratio, tested as of the last day of each fiscal quarter on a trailing four-quarter basis, to be less than 1.25 to 1.00.
claims.quote:
§7.11 Debt Service Coverage Ratio.
(a) Minimum Ratio. The Borrower shall not permit the Debt Service Coverage Ratio, tested as of the last day of each fiscal quarter on a trailing four-quarter basis, to be less than 1.25 to 1.00.

claims.text: No add-back or other adjustment shall be made to Consolidated EBITDA for purposes of this Section 7.11, except as expressly provided in this Agreement as amended in writing.
